segments.name: HPC Hosting Business
segments.description: Designs, builds, owns and operates purpose-built HPC data centers leased to hyperscalers for AI and accelerated-compute workloads.
segments.evidence: Our HPC Hosting Business designs, constructs, owns, and operates next-generation data centers purpose-built to host high-density GPU and other accelerated-compute infrastructure for AI, machine learning, and other HPC applications.

segments.name: Data Center Hosting Business
segments.description: Provides energized infrastructure to a single legacy crypto mining customer to deploy equipment based on its power requirements.
segments.evidence: Our Data Center Hosting Business provides energized infrastructure allowing the customer to deploy equipment based on its power requirements.
